arxiv-1907-12941.title: Stratify or Inject: Two Simple Training Strategies to Improve Brain Tumor Segmentation
arxiv-1907-12941.creator: Raphael Meier 1, Michael Rebsamen 1, Urspeter Knecht 2, Mauricio Reyes 2,3, Roland Wiest 1, Richard McKinley 1
arxiv-1907-12941.description: Abstract Deep learning methods for brain tumor segmentation are typically trained in an ad hoc fashion on all available data. Brain tumors are tremendously heterogeneous in image appearance and labeled training data is limited. We argue that incorporation of additional prior information, specifically tumor grade, associated with tumor imaging phenotypes during model training can significantly improve segmentation performance.

arxiv-2105-02891.title: Gate-defined wires in twisted bilayer graphene: from electrical detection of inter-valley coherence to internally engineered Majorana modes
arxiv-2105-02891.creator: Alex Thomson, Ina M. Sorensen, Stevan Nadj-Perge, Jason Alicea
arxiv-2105-02891.description: Abstract Twisted bilayer graphene (TBG) realizes a highly tunable, strongly interacting system featuring superconductivity and various correlated insulating states. We establish gate-defined wires in TBG with proximity-induced spin-orbit coupling as ( i ) (i) a tool for revealing the nature of correlated insulators and ( i ​ i ) (ii) a platform for Majorana-based topological qubits.

arxiv-2209-12758.title: Overcoming Referential Ambiguity in language-guided goal-conditioned Reinforcement Learning
arxiv-2209-12758.creator: Hugo Caselles-Dupré, Olivier Sigaud, Mohamed Chetouani
arxiv-2209-12758.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Hugo Caselles-Dupré, Olivier Sigaud, Mohamed Chetouani. Teaching an agent to perform new tasks using natural language can easily be hindered by ambiguities in interpretation. When a teacher provides an instruction to a learner about an object by referring to its features, the learner can misunderstand the teacher’s intentions, for instance if the instruction ambiguously refer to features of the object, a phenomenon called referential ambiguity .

arxiv-2405-01150.title: Performance Analysis of Reconfigurable Holographic Surfaces in the Near-Field Scenario of Cell-Free Networks Under Hardware Impairments Thanks: Lajos Hanzo would like to acknowledge the financial support of the Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council projects EP/W016605/1, EP/X01228X/1, E
arxiv-2405-01150.creator: Qingchao Li, Graduate Student Member, IEEE, Mohammed El-Hajjar, Senior Member, IEEE
arxiv-2405-01150.description: Abstract We propose a hybrid beamforming architecture for near-field reconfigurable holographic surfaces (RHS) harnessed in cell-free networks. Specifically, the holographic beamformer of each base station (BS) is designed for maximizing the channel gain based on the local channel state information (CSI).

arxiv-2405-02458.title: Controlled Query Evaluation through Epistemic Dependencies
arxiv-2405-02458.creator: Gianluca Cima, Domenico Lembo, Lorenzo Marconi, Riccardo Rosati, Domenico Fabio Savo
arxiv-2405-02458.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Gianluca Cima, Domenico Lembo, Lorenzo Marconi, Riccardo Rosati, Domenico Fabio Savo. In this paper, we propose the use of epistemic dependencies to express data protection policies in Controlled Query Evaluation (CQE), which is a form of confidentiality-preserving query answering over ontologies and databases. The resulting policy language goes significantly beyond those proposed in the literature on CQE so far, allowing for very rich and practically interesting forms of data protection rules.

arxiv-2409-01929.title: On the gcd-graphs over polynomial rings Thanks: JM is partially supported by the Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada (NSERC) grant R0370A01. He gratefully acknowledges the Western University Faculty of Science Distinguished Professorship 2020-2021. TTN is partially supported
arxiv-2409-01929.creator: Ján Mináč, Tung T. Nguyen, Nguy ê ~ \tilde{\text{\^{e}}} n Duy Tân
arxiv-2409-01929.description: Abstract . Gcd-graphs over the ring of integers modulo n n are a natural generalization of unitary Cayley graphs. The study of these graphs has foundations in various mathematical fields, including number theory, ring theory, and representation theory. Using the theory of Ramanujan sums, it is known that these gcd-graphs have integral spectra; i.e., all their eigenvalues are integers.

arxiv-2505-14175.title: Destabilizing Power Grid and Energy Market by Cyberattacks on Smart Inverters Conference: Preprint; 2025; ACM eEnergy
arxiv-2505-14175.creator: Xiangyu Hui, Samuel Karumba, Sid Chi-Kin Chau, Mohiuddin Ahmed
arxiv-2505-14175.description: Abstract . Cyberattacks on smart inverters and distributed PV are becoming an imminent threat, because of the recent well-documented vulnerabilities and attack incidents. Particularly, the long lifespan of inverter devices, users’ oblivion of cybersecurity compliance, and the lack of cyber regulatory frameworks exacerbate the prospect of cyberattacks on smart inverters.

plos-pone-0010508.title: Evaluation of the Prognostic Value of IFN-γ Release Assay and Tuberculin Skin Test in Household Contacts of Infectious Tuberculosis Cases in Senegal
plos-pone-0010508.creator: Christian Lienhardt, Katherine Fielding, Abdoul A. Hane et al.
plos-pone-0010508.description: PLOS ONE research article. Chemoprophylaxis of contacts of infectious tuberculosis (TB) cases is recommended for TB control, particularly in endemic countries, but is hampered by the difficulty to diagnose latent TB infection (LTBI), classically assessed through response to the Tuberculin Skin Test (TST).

pmc-10663405.title: Inhibition of Quorum Sensing Controlled Virulence Factors and Biofilm Formation of Streptococcus mutans Isolated From Orthodontic Subjects by 4-Hydroxycinnamic Acid
pmc-10663405.creator: Kavitha Ramsundar, Ravindra Kumar Jain, Sankar G Pitchaipillai
pmc-10663405.description: IntroductionDental plaque biofilms are a collection of microorganisms that are adhered to the tooth enamel surface. Inhibition of plaque biofilms is required to prevent dental caries and periodontitis and currently, there are many chemical and herbal products in use for inhibition of biofilms but with limited success.

pmc-11355734.title: Experimental Assessment of Hemp Shiv and Green Adhesives to Produce a Biocomposite Material
pmc-11355734.creator: Borja Martínez, Virginia Mendizabal, Ernest Bernat-Masó, Lluís Gil, Francisco Javier Espinach Orús, Philippe Evon
pmc-11355734.description: This study investigated the utilization of innovative green composites made from hemp shiv, a waste by-product of hemp cultivation, with the aim of promoting sustainability within the construction industry. The manufacturing method involved the application of pressure in a mold to create the samples.

pmc-11483941.title: Charge Scaling in Classical Force Fields for Lithium Ions in Polymers
pmc-11483941.creator: Dongyue Liang, Yuxi Chen, Chuting Deng, Juan J de Pablo
pmc-11483941.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Polymer electrolytes are of interest for applications in energy storage. Molecular simulations of ion transport in polymer electrolytes have been widely used to study the conductivity in these materials. Such simulations have generally relied on classical force fields. A peculiar feature of such force fields has been that in the particular case of lithium ions (Li+), their charge must be scaled down by approximately 20% to achieve agreement with experimental measurements of ion diffusivity.

pmc-11538588.title: Ultrasound-Guided Percutaneous Tracheostomy in Cardiovascular and Thoracic Surgery of South Korea: Retrospective Evaluation of Efficacy and Safety in Critically Ill Patients
pmc-11538588.creator: Young Hyun Lee, Dong Hoon Kang, Hyun Oh Park
pmc-11538588.description: BackgroundIn intensive care settings, the maintenance of ventilation is typically essential. Tracheostomy is frequently performed to facilitate long-term ventilation and to minimize associated complications. This procedure can be conducted using several techniques, including traditional surgery, endoscopic approaches, and ultrasound-guided methods.

pmc-12580782.title: Evaluation of Proton Minibeam Radiotherapy on Antitumor Immune Responses in a Rat Model of Glioblastoma
pmc-12580782.creator: Lorea Iturri, Miriam Riquelme-Perez, Pierre-Emannuel Bonté, Sarah Potiron, Christel Goudot, Marjorie Juchaux, Elise Brisebard, Cristèle Gilbert, Julie Espenon, Ramón Ortiz, Annalisa Patriarca, Ludovic De Marzi, Sebastián Amigorena, Yolanda Prezado
pmc-12580782.description: The authors demonstrate how proton minibeam radiotherapy (pMBRT) generates antitumor immunity through CD4+ and CD8+ T cells tumor infiltration. Single-cell transcriptomics reveals enhanced antibody production, elevated expression of chemotactic cytokines, and activation of interferon signaling pathways after pMBRT. Introduction Cancer accounts for 25% of all deaths in Europe, and radiotherapy (RT) is a cornerstone of cancer treatment.

pmc-12585778.title: Visualizing Biological Systems at the Molecular and Cellular Level at the Laboratory for BioMolecular Structure
pmc-12585778.creator: Liguo Wang, Guobin Hu, Jake Kaminsky, Qun Liu, Sean McSweeney
pmc-12585778.description: In recent years, cryo-Electron Tomography (cryo-ET) has garnered increasing attention due to its unique capability for direct visualization of interactions between complexes in their cellular environment. It offers unparalleled insights into molecular organization, cellular structure, and cell physiology, making it a powerful tool for probing intricate details at the nanoscale within a cellular context.

pmc-12801768.title: The association between animal‑based and plant‑based protein intake with sleep quality, mood, anxiety, depression and stress among elderly: a cross-sectional study
pmc-12801768.creator: Batoul Ghosn, Hanieh Abbasi, Parisa Nezhad Hajian, Leila Azadbakht
pmc-12801768.description: BackgroundDietary protein intake may influence sleep quality, mood, anxiety, depression, and stress in older adults, but evidence is limited. This study examined the impact of protein source (animal vs. plant) and quantity on these outcomes in the elderly.MethodsIn this cross‑sectional study, 396 Iranian adults aged 65–85 years with sleep or mental health challenges were recruited from hospitals and clinics.

pmc-13141865.title: Emergence and characterization of new OXA-181 variants in France: OXA-1181, OXA-1201, OXA-1205, OXA-1207, and OXA-1226
pmc-13141865.creator: Léa Bientz, Réva Nermont, Cécile Emeraud, Thierry Naas, Rémy A. Bonnin, Laurent Dortet
pmc-13141865.description: Since 2022, the diversity of OXA-48 variants has increased in France. We analyzed the dissemination of five recent variants (OXA-1181, OXA-1201, OXA-1205, OXA-1207, and OXA-1226) mostly identified on plasmids in high-risk Escherichia coli clones. Three of them (OXA-1181, OXA-1205, and OXA-1207) displayed the same Ser244Trp substitution with no significant impact on the β-lactams hydrolytic profile.

pmc-13348002.title: SOT102, a novel CLDN18.2-targeting antibody-drug conjugate, exhibits strong therapeutic potential in solid tumors
pmc-13348002.creator: Iva Valentová, Lenka Kyrych Sadílková, Lukas Bammert, Lorenz Waldmeier, Roger Beerli, Ilona Procházková, Filip Jabůrek, Tatiana Spitzová, Eliška Kohelová, Kati Räsänen, Ulrich Moebius, Radek Špíšek
pmc-13348002.description: BackgroundPatients with gastric and pancreatic cancers, as well as other solid tumors including ovarian, lung, liver, and colon cancers, often lack effective therapeutic options. Claudin 18.2 (CLDN18.2) is a tumor-associated target that is predominantly expressed in gastric and pancreatic cancers but also found in several other tumor types. SOT102 is a novel antibody–drug conjugate directed against CLDN18.

pmc-13363759.title: Text-to-Korean Sign Language Pose Sequence Generation Using Non-Manual Signal Conditioning and Multi-Scale Temporal Refinement
pmc-13363759.creator: Seungju Lee, Gooman Park
pmc-13363759.description: Automatic sign language generation has the potential to support information accessibility for deaf and hard-of-hearing individuals. Generating sign language pose sequences from natural language text can serve as an intermediate representation for avatar-based sign language expression and sign language video synthesis.

pmc-13428184.title: Cytokine Gene Variants Are Associated With Aerobic Fitness‐Related, Hematological, and Metabolic Traits in Healthy Adults
pmc-13428184.creator: Kinga Humińska‐Lisowska, Barkın Bıçakçı, Monika Michałowska‐Sawczyn, Piotr Aschenbrenner, Alison V. September, Patrizia Proia, Agata Leońska‐Duniec

pmc-13503100.title: COVID-19 advanced cardiovascular and clinical phenotyping dataset
pmc-13503100.creator: Oscar E Barreras, Daniel Cuevas-González, Marco A Reyna, Edgar García-Duarte, Juan Pablo García-Vázquez, Juan C Delgado-Torres, Martin Aaron Sánchez-Barajas, Roberto L Avitia
pmc-13503100.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This article describes a structured clinical dataset collected from 100 adult patients who were previously hospitalized due to moderate-to-severe COVID-19 infection. Data were obtained prospectively at a second-level care hospital in Mexicali, Baja California, Mexico. The dataset includes demographic characteristics, anthropometric measurements, traditional cardiovascular risk factors, general blood test, Questionnaire-derived variables, 12-lead electrocardiographic (ECG) parameters, signal-averaged electrocardiogram (SAECG) measurements, and heart rate variability (HRV) metrics. Questionnaire-derived variables include medical history, cardiovascular risk factors, medication use, lifestyle-related factors, and COVID-19 vaccination information.

pmc-13641143.title: Comprehensive somatic profiling of gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine neoplasms
pmc-13641143.creator: Chirayu Mohindroo, Parul Agarwal, Valerie Lee, Jin He, Robert Anders, Katherine Bever, Daniel Laheru, Ana De Jesus-Acosta
pmc-13641143.description: BackgroundThe incidence of gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine neoplasms (GEP-NENs) is rising, yet their biological heterogeneity and variable response to treatments remain poorly understood. Comprehensive genomic characterization may uncover somatic drivers and inform biomarker-driven therapeutic strategies.MethodsWe retrospectively analyzed clinically ordered next-generation sequencing (NGS) results from tumor samples of 111 patients with confirmed GEP-NENs treated at Johns Hopkins Hospital between 2020 and 2022.

uslaw-usc-t12-s1701w.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t12-s1701w.description: United States Code, Title 12 (Banks And Banking); Chapter 13 (National Housing). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Secretary of Housing and Urban Development is authorized to provide, or contract with public or private organizations to provide, such budget, debt management, and related counseling services to mortgagors whose mortgages are insured under section 1715z(i) or (j)(4) of this title as he determines.
